[SWS_DM_01023] Calling ExecuteReset() if positive response shall be sent be-
fore reset
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04279
⌈
If the parameter
DiagnosticEcuResetClass.respondToReset
is either not
present or present and set to
respondBeforeReset
and the Diagnostic Server in-
stance has sent the positive response according to [SWS_DM_00268], the Diagnostic
Server instance shall call
ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::ExecuteReset
.
⌋
